result.topic_en: The page ends an argument about domains and branch points for a function represented by infinite series, then shows that for any countable set of real points with prescribed values one can construct a series of polynomials taking those values, using a zigzag-line construction.

then $x$ gegeben ist und in jedem dieser Wer-
the $x$ ein zugehöriger Funktionenwerth $f(x)$
so kann man stets eine nach ganzen rationalen
Funktionen fortschreitende Reihe herstellen,

items.english: If a countable set of real values x is given, and at each of these values x an associated function value f(x), then one can always construct a series proceeding in polynomials (entire rational functions) which takes the given values f(x) at the points x.
